description: Search canonical graph node identifiers, names and descriptions without scraping human pages. Optionally restrict to one node type. Results return canonical zenitheye.net URLs; use knowledge_graph_neighbors after selecting a node to traverse explicit relations.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching graph nodes to return.

node_type.description: Optional canonical node class; defaults to any.

q.description: Case-insensitive text matched against canonical node IDs, names and available descriptions.

name: knowledge_graph_search
title: Search ZenithEye Knowledge Graph
